name: Windows Autopilot
short_description: A collection of Microsoft technologies used to set up and pre-configure new Windows devices and enroll them into Microsoft Intune, with deployment modes such as user-driven, self-deploying and pre-provisioning.

evidence.quote: Intune and Autopilot at Scale - What Breaks in Real Rollouts
That's the promise behind Windows Autopilot, and it's why a new hire can be productive on day one instead of day five.
Microsoft describes autopilot as a collection of technologies used to set up and pre-configure new devices
